maya: Heads-up — PR #9342 is blocked by CI. Windows snapshot lane failed on the `model-serving` tests, looks like a single snapshot mismatch. Anyone free to take a quick look?

sam: I can check in a few mins. Do we have the failing diff from CI?

ci-bot: job: windows-snap
status: failed
log excerpt:
```
--- expected
+++ actual
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
-Model started with seed=42
+Model started with seed=137
-Serving: OK
+Serving: OK
```

kevin: hmm seed difference suggests non-determinism in test RNG. Was there a recent change around random seeding or env vars?

maya: Not that I'm aware of in this PR — it's mostly refactor. The test sets seed explicitly, though. Could be Windows-specific timing?

sam: Rerunning the job now: <https://ci.internal/rebuild/9342|rebuild link>

ci-bot: rerun triggered by sam — windows-snap

ci-bot: job: windows-snap (rerun)#2
status: passed

sam: Passed on rerun. Marking as flaky for now.

maya: Ok thanks. Can we avoid landing until we figure root cause? If it's truly flaky we should add a retry decorator or make the test less timing-sensitive.

kevin: Agreed. Quick triage plan: 1) reproduce locally on Windows VM with the same env. 2) run `pytest tests/serving/test_startup.py::test_seeded_startup -k windows -q --rand-seed=137` locally and compare. 3) if nondet, add explicit seed or mock RNG.

sam: I can do step 1/2 today. If I can't repro locally, I'll add a 3x retry on CI as a band-aid and file a follow-up to properly fix.

maya: @sam thanks — please post the local run output here. If you can't reproduce, go ahead with temporary retry but add a TODO ticket.

sam: will do. tagging this thread :eyes: and temporarily blocking merge until follow-up is filed.

kevin: Also adding a short note to the flaky-tests board: "PR 9342 — windows snapshot nondeterministic (seed mismatch)."

maya: cool. I'll hold the merge and update the PR description to explain the blocker.

sam: local run output (WM VM):
```
pytest tests/serving/test_startup.py::test_seeded_startup -q
collected 1 item

tests/serving/test_startup.py .                                    [100%]
```
No repro locally yet. Will try with stress loop.

maya: thanks — keep us posted. If it reappears i'll ping infra for a deeper Windows image diff.

ci-bot: note: added label `ci:flaky` to PR #9342
